```lean
theorem lg_target {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [LE β] [Zero β] {v₁ : α₁ → β} {v₂ : α₂ → β} : 0 ≤ Sum.elim v₁ v₂ ↔ 0 ≤ v₁ ∧ 0 ≤ v₂ := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    split
    · intros a b
      apply h
      exact a
      exact b
    · intro h'
      split
      · apply h'.1
      · apply h'.2
  · intro h'
    split
    · apply h'.1
    · apply h'.2
    constructor
    · intros a b
      apply h'
      exact a
      exact b
```
